# Pre97 immutable family/postman baseline

Captured before any97 mapping with `cycle97/story/capture-baseline.cjs`. Three actual source consumers: story_family_key, main_recovery_story_family_key, postman_again; all 6 authored outcomes. Controlled entry/payment fixtures use normal in-cap resources and isolated VM. They are not new journey players.

Four `actual96-*` files are byte copies of natural seed961287 entry/paid files. SHA256.json and baseline.provenance bind copies to their immutable96 originals. Do not regenerate or rewrite old words/receipts to satisfy current expectations.

New receipts opt into revision qa97. Legacy is null because these events had no timed selector. Old view, reading, text-only and clocked text-only receipts keep old scene keys and all paid metadata. Old unpaid entry keeps the old view; its newly made payment opts into qa97. Current timing uses actual event clock, not historical audio origin, and roles/body/fx remain unchanged.
